desktopOnly: Backup and restore are only available in the desktop app.

backup.title: Data backup
backup.description: Creates a portable backup file (.cwtbackup) from the current profile's collected data. Settings and secret values are not included.

restore.title: Data restore (import)
restore.description: Imports a backup file into the currently active profile. Existing items are automatically skipped as duplicates. To import into a new profile, first create and switch to it in Settings, then restore.

wipe.title: Danger zone — delete all data
wipe.description: Permanently deletes all data collected for this profile (conversations, audit logs, usage, agents, consumption, flow runs, credit alerts, and more). App registration and settings are kept. This cannot be undone — back up first.
wipe.button: Delete all data for this profile
wipe.confirmPrompt: Press again to permanently delete. This cannot be undone.
